title: MM6 Jackalman
description: Original MM6 jackalman A: tall black jackal-headed Egyptian guardian with two very long erect narrow ears, long dark canine muzzle and small yellow-gold eyes. Muscular charcoal-black body with silver-grey sculpted chest highlights, gold collar and arm bands, gold wrist cuffs, belt and thin gold-strapped dark sandals. Original royal-blue pleated short wrap skirt and blue headcloth panels trimmed in gold. Holds a tall thin dark staff in the right hand (image left), topped by the native narrow hooked silver loop, with gold and small blue bands on the shaft. Preserve the native body proportions, ear silhouette, muzzle, outfit, staff length and exact poses. Dark almost-black skin, restrained silver highlights; do not turn the skin grey or bronze. No new jewelry, weapons or ancient scenery.
regions: Enhanced blue skirt and headcloth coverage only; cyan staff bands, gold trim, black body and silver hook are protected.
